text:
Nora (Partnerships): Heads-up — upcoming hardware partner listing needs HSM attestation + SOC artifacts. Partners are asking for a clear machine-friendly manifest and an automated redaction flow. Can we define a small "manifest v2" and a partner GH Actions example they can run to push evidence?

Priya (HW Partner): We can automate from our CI. important: our HSM vendor can provide a signed device-attestation blob (binary) and a PKCS7 signature. need to know how you want that preserved.

Diego (Security Eng): For HSM stuff: store device-attestation under hsm/attestation.bin and signature as hsm/attestation.sig. Manifest v2 should include a fingerprint (sha256) of attestation, an "endorsement_type" field (e.g., pkcs7|jwt), and a short scope string. Also want a machine-check step that validates signature against our keyset before ingest.

Kelsey (Marketplace PM): timeline constraints: marketing needs tag week-of 06/10 for the listing page draft. can security verification finish by 06/03?

Diego (Security Eng): yes if partners use the GH Action to run pre-redaction checks. i'll paste a minimal manifest + GH Action snippet.

Diego (Security Eng): manifest-v2 example:
```yaml
schema: redwood.Manifest.v2
version: 2
owner: priya@acme-hw.example
artifacts:
  - path: soc2/soc2-type2.pdf
    sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924
    type: soc2
  - path: hsm/attestation.bin
    sha256: 4d7f9b2c6a0f2f3e8a7a
    type: hsm_attestation
    endorsement_type: pkcs7
  - path: pentest/report.pdf
    sha256: a7c9d5e9b3f1
    type: pentest
metadata:
  upload_date: 2025-05-20T14:00:00Z
  region: us-gov-west-1
  contact: priya@acme-hw.example
```

Diego (Security Eng): GH Actions example (partner side) — it will run redaction checks, compute hashes, and call our presign endpoint then upload:
```yaml
name: evidence-publish
on: [workflow_dispatch]
jobs:
  prepare-and-upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: run redaction check
        run: |
          python tools/check_redaction.py --dir artifacts || exit 1
      - name: compute manifest
        run: |
          python tools/make_manifest_v2.py --dir artifacts --out manifest.yaml
      - name: request presign
        run: |
          PRESIGN=$(curl -s -X POST "https://ingest.redwood.example/presign" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_TOKEN }}" -d @manifest.yaml)
          echo "$PRESIGN" > presign.json
      - name: upload files
        run: |
          python tools/upload_with_presign.py presign.json artifacts.zip
```

Priya (HW Partner): that looks doable. what about redaction automation? our reports include logs with IPs — we can run a scrub tool but need a sample regex list to match Redwood expectations.

Diego (Security Eng): we'll publish a tiny redaction ruleset repo. key points: remove any customer PII, replace with <REDACTED>, and for logs prefer truncated hashes rather than full tokens. we'll accept an "interim attestation" if full redaction pending but that delays public listing.

Omar (Legal): legal asks: for gov/regional listings (us-gov/eur), we need an explicit statement of data residency + who signs the attestation. also require partner to confirm they have rights to share pen-test findings. i'll add a short checkbox block to the manifest metadata.

Nora (Partnerships): can upload-bot create a draft ticket template for partners so they include all fields?

upload-bot: Created ticket: COMPLY-2001 "Partner evidence automation template" assigned to Nora.

Kelsey (Marketplace PM): ops note: retention policy - keep evidence in secure bucket for 18 months, then archive to cold storage for 12 months, then delete. but for gov listings we keep 36 months. put this in the runbook.

Diego (Security Eng): verification script we run server-side will: 1) validate manifest schema v2 2) check sha256s match artifacts 3) validate attestation signature 4) run automated redaction heuristics (flag only) 5) spin up ephemeral scanner for CVE re-scan if pentest shows high-risk. I'll add the pseudocode to the repo.

Priya (HW Partner): two practical asks: 1) Can you accept PKCS7 signatures as separate files? 2) Any size limits for attestation blobs?

Diego (Security Eng): 1) yes (hsm/attestation.sig) 2) attestation blobs up to 10MB preferred; if bigger, we can host externally and reference URL in manifest with signed access.

Omar (Legal): add: sample attestation language available here: https://drive.redwood.example/legal/partner-attestation-sample.md — partners should include their name, title, and the date. PGP signatures are optional but helpful.

Nora (Partnerships): Plan of record:
- Partners adopt manifest v2 and GH Action by 2025-05-15
- Upload window (presign flow) 2025-05-20 -> 2025-06-03
- Security verification complete by 2025-06-06
- Marketing draft week 06/10

Kelsey (Marketplace PM): confirmed. we'll block marketing calendar but mark as "listing conditional" until final green.

Diego (Security Eng): i'll open a small repo with the manifest schema, redaction rules, and verification tooling. link will be posted in this thread.

upload-bot: Action created: #COMPLY-2002 "Publish manifest-v2 spec and tools" assigned to Diego. Due 2025-04-28.

Nora (Partnerships): thanks everyone. I'll compile this into a one-pager and the partner-facing checklist. please flag anything missing in the next 24h. :pray:
